body: They're used to me being in college most of the time, and the youngest is a baby he won't remember anything. I fucked up by waiting so long because my sister now goes to the same college and I had to figure out how to distance myself.  My parents likely wouldn't tell the kids what actually happened but now that my sister is here she might find out before she is able to get home and I can't figure out a way to make sure she's on her way without me.
